description.html: The Habistat Dial thermometer is a reliable analog device for measuring the temperature in a terrarium. Monitoring temperature is key to reptile health, because reptiles are ectothermic animals that depend on external heat sources to regulate their body temperature. The compact round dial with a clear scale in degrees Celsius and Fahrenheit allows quick temperature readings. The thermometer sticks directly to the inside of the terrarium glass, with no cables or batteries needed. We recommend placing it where your animal spends the most time. For optimal conditions, the terrarium should have a temperature gradient - a warmer and a cooler side - so the animal can regulate its own temperature. Use two thermometers - one on the warm side and one on the cool side.
